bash: python3 - <<'EOF'
p = '/root/.bashrc'
s = open(p).read()
block = '''
# KLEE + STP (installed under /opt)
export PATH="/opt/klee/bin:/opt/stp/bin:$PATH"
export CPATH="/opt/klee/include:/opt/stp/include${CPATH:+:$CPATH}"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/opt/klee/lib:/opt/stp/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
'''
assert s.count(block) == 1
s = s.replace(block, '')
anchor = '# If not running interactively, don\'t do anything\n[ -z "$PS1" ] && return\n'
assert s.count(anchor) == 1
s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + block)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("moved block above interactive guard")
EOF
sed -n '1,14p' /root/.bashrc
